reuseRule: Mandatory global cockpit standard: use this exact visual family and OFF/ON asset pair for every toggle switch anywhere in the entire cockpit and all overhead panels. Do not regenerate, redraw, recolor, translate a single frame, or substitute it. Only the system logic and required number of detents may differ.

variants.threePosition: same visual family with the locked b737-toggle-center.png center-state frame
variants.springLoaded: same visual family with automatic return timing
variants.guarded: same toggle asset plus a separately approved guard asset
